latest.subject: Thank you! You just helped improve someone's life!

fields.text:
Congratulations!! 
 
We just received an order for C344738 Logan Wetzler(Creekview Towns) from Stiltz
of Charlotte : Stiltz of Greenville & Spartanburg.  

This is another customer that will enjoy the benefits of having a Stiltz Lift. 

You played a big part in helping improve their quality of life!

Thank you!
 
ISR - Karen Portnoy
CSR - - Paul Orlando
DSM - Ryan Doherty
